newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Fujimori to speak to the nation - radio.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Fujimori to speak to the nation - radio.

text.p: Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori was due to make his first public statement on the ongoing hostage crisis, local radio reported on Saturday.
Radio Programas Radio said at 10:30 p.m. EST (0330 GMT on Sunday) that Fujimori would speak "in the next few minutes."
Government Palace officials could not immediately confirm the report.
Fujimori has been silent in public since Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrillas stormed the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima Tuesday night.
The Peruvian president was also due to meet Japanese Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda Saturday night.
